conclusion: On clean labels (outlier_fraction 0.0), across the full budget of seeds 7, 19, and 31 and metrics mse, mae, and median_absolute_error, OLS linear regression achieved lower error than the matched training-mean baseline in every seed-metric combination. This is a bounded synthetic regression result and does not establish general scientific value.
limitations: Results are limited to the clean-label (outlier_fraction 0.0) configuration and this task version.
Only three seeds (7, 19, 31) were executed; no broader seed sweep was run.
No statistical test or confidence interval was computed.
No claim of general scientific value is made.
